name: dataful
description: Search, explore and download Indian public datasets from the Dataful catalogue.

interface.longDescription:
Dataful standardises India’s public data from government portals, ministry bulletins, regulator filings, and other authoritative sources into clean, structured, ready-to-use datasets.

Discover relevant datasets, preview records, understand metadata, and download data in seconds. Dataful makes fragmented and difficult-to-use public data easier to find, compare, analyse, and reuse across topics such as elections, economy, health, education, infrastructure, environment, corporate affairs, and governance.

Built for researchers, analysts, policymakers, businesses, journalists, and anyone working with Indian public data, Dataful helps you spend less time cleaning and locating data and more time finding insights.
defaultPrompt: How will India's working-age population change by 2036?
Compare rural and urban inflation in India over the last five years.
Which Indian states have the highest multidimensional poverty?

positive.description: Answer a question from a dataset by finding, checking and downloading it.
positive.prompt: How will India's working-age population change by 2036?
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the Population Projection of India (2011 - 2036) dataset (https://dataful.in/datasets/1301), checks it, downloads it, answers from the file and cites the dataset page.

positive.description: Report a dataset's structure from its metadata.
positive.prompt: What columns does the CPI master dataset have, and how many rows?
positive.expected_behavior: Finds Consumer Price Index (CPI) - Master Data (https://dataful.in/datasets/17507) and reports its column names and row count, citing the dataset page.

positive.description: Browse datasets in a sector using the filter tools.
positive.prompt: What datasets does Dataful have on agriculture?
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the agriculture sector, then lists datasets in it with titles and short descriptions.

positive.description: Handle a paid dataset the account is not entitled to.
positive.prompt: Analyse Delhi's air quality over the last 3 years.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the Day wise, State wise Air Quality Index (AQI) dataset (https://dataful.in/datasets/18571). When the account has no access, explains that the download was refused, gives the dataset page, and does not answer from the preview rows.

positive.description: List the user's own recent downloads.
positive.prompt: Which datasets did I download last month?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the user's own downloads from last month, newest first, with dataset titles, formats and download dates.

negative.description: Do not trigger for live weather. Dataful holds published datasets, not live weather.
negative.prompt: What's the weather in Delhi today?

negative.description: Do not trigger for creative writing. The request does not need data.
negative.prompt: Write me a poem about the monsoon.

negative.description: Do not trigger for analysing a file the user already has. The user is working with their own file, not the Dataful catalogue.
negative.prompt: Here is my sales spreadsheet, make a chart of monthly revenue.

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments. Paid datasets can only be downloaded by accounts already entitled to them.

publication.release_notes: Initial release: search, browse, inspect and download Indian public datasets from the Dataful catalogue.
